body.purpose: Navigation, controls, body copy, and metadata.

mono.purpose: Terminal output, paths, and commands only.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and compact control state.

motion.name: structure
motion.purpose: Sidebar, modal, and responsive structural transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Achromatic principal action with compact developer-tool density.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 13px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--button-bg, oklch(0.14 0.006 120)); color: var(--button-ink, oklch(1 0 0)); font: 610 13px/1.5 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--button-hover, oklch(0.23 0.01 120)); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.43 0.105 120)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Border-led secondary action for toolbars and settings.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 36px; padding: 7px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(0.89 0.007 120)); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--surface-raised, oklch(1 0 0)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.18 0.012 120)); font: 610 13px/1.5 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, oklch(0.957 0.006 120)); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.43 0.105 120)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Explicitly labeled neutral field with olive focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: var(--ink, oklch(0.18 0.012 120)); font: 630 11px/1.4 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 8px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(0.89 0.007 120)); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--bg, oklch(1 0 0)); color: inherit; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--primary, oklch(0.43 0.105 120)); outline: 2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.43 0.105 120)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Agent Chip
components.description: Quiet identity token for enabled Agents.
components.css: .ds-agent-chip { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(0.89 0.007 120)); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted, oklch(0.46 0.014 120)); font: 600 10px/1.4 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Navigation Row
components.description: Familiar sidebar row with tonal active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { width: 100%; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--surface-strong, oklch(0.944 0.006 120)); color: var(--ink, oklch(0.18 0.012 120)); text-align: left; font: 610 13px/1.5 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, oklch(0.957 0.006 120)); } .ds-nav-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.43 0.105 120)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Terminal Panel
components.description: Primary executable work surface with visible connection state.
components.css: .ds-terminal { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(0.89 0.007 120)); border-radius: var(--radius-md, 9px); background: oklch(0.075 0 0); color: oklch(0.93 0.006 120); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; } .ds-terminal header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.235 0.008 120); font: 600 11px/1.4 'Inter Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-terminal header small { color: oklch(0.7 0.012 120); } .ds-status { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.72 0.14 145); } .ds-terminal pre { min-height: 110px; margin: 0; padding: 13px; font: 400 13px/1.45 'JetBrains Mono Variable', monospace; white-space: pre-wrap; }

narrative.overview: AgentDock feels like the desk of a developer who switches between focused daytime work and long evening terminal sessions: the surface stays neutral, the tools are exactly where muscle memory expects them, and only live system state asks for attention. White and near-black carry the product; muted olive behaves like a controlled instrument lamp, never like decoration. The system is compact without becoming cramped. Borders and tonal shifts explain structure, while labels, paths, timestamps, and terminal text form a disciplined information hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Pure white and near-black canvases with one restrained olive signal.
Flat, border-led grouping with dense but readable developer-tool rhythm.
Inter for interface language and JetBrains Mono for paths, commands, and terminal output.
Familiar side navigation, session tabs, dialogs, fields, and visible focus states.
Responsive structure that collapses navigation and simplifies toolbars instead of shrinking text.

rules.name: The Instrument Lamp Rule
rules.body: Olive is a state signal, not decoration; if it appears in a background flourish or large inactive surface, the screen is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Canvases Rule
rules.body: Light mode starts from literal white and dark mode from chroma-free near-black. Never warm either canvas into cream, beige, navy, or purple.

rules.name: The Executable Content Rule
rules.body: Mono identifies something the machine reads or runs. Buttons, navigation, headings, and explanatory prose always remain in Inter.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: If a resting container needs a shadow to be understood, repair its hierarchy, spacing, or surface tone instead.

dos: Do keep primary actions achromatic and reserve olive for focus, selection, readiness, and the active session rule.
Do keep body text at or above WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in both themes and provide non-color state labels.
Do use standard sidebars, tabs, dialogs, switches, and fields so the interface disappears into the developer's task.
Do simplify toolbars, collapse the sidebar, and preserve touch targets on narrow screens.
Do show YOLO scope, container status, background apt maintenance, empty states, errors, and stopped sessions honestly.
donts: Don't use purple or neon gradients, decorative glassmorphism, or the generic AI product visual language named in PRODUCT.md.
Don't use excessive rounding, nested cards, fake terminal scenery, or borders combined with broad decorative shadows.
Don't hide project settings, Agent selection, or runtime state behind novel gestures or hover-only controls.
Don't use cream, beige, navy, or tinted-black canvases; the product is explicitly white or chroma-free near-black.
Don't animate decoration. Motion exists only for state transition, feedback, responsive navigation, modal entry, and loading.
